lineage.description: Population settlement locations in Borno State were mapped using the Displacement Tracking Matrix methodology, which tracks displaced populations and their settlement patterns. The dataset represents a spatial inventory of populated places as of June 2018, derived from DTM field assessments and compiled by iMMAP with WHO and Health Sector partners.

sources.name: Displacement Tracking Matrix
sources.description: IOM's DTM provides population movement and settlement location data in displacement-affected areas, used here to map populated settlements in Borno State
